proves.claim: deferredGateUnsettled holds an open item as GATE_AT_HEAD at 1 h, stops holding it once its deferred gate job is older than GATE_SETTLE_HOLD_MS with no gate-shard job offered or claimed, keeps holding while a shard is live, and ends the hold on an edit or refreeze after the job.

store.io-board-next-gate-expiry.deferred.why: Without this case a deferred gate that nothing will settle could hide its item from next forever, as #10700 sat 16 h and rooted 15 waiting items.

proves.claim: gateShardsUnsettled holds a claim on an unknown settle only when the gate job was submitted by the item's current owner and only for GATE_UNKNOWN_HOLD_MS from the settled note, so itemWorkInFlight frees it at 5 h and never for a previous holder's gate, while red and green settles hold nothing as before.

store.io-board-next-gate-expiry.unknown-.why: Without this case an unknown settle could pin a claim forever, including a new holder's claim on a previous holder's gate, so the stale sweep never freed it.
